title: Listing bite-sized copy lab and integration acceptance (draft)
body:
Purpose:
This working doc collects short-form tile copy variants, a compact set of integration acceptance criteria, and a lightweight rollout plan for the first beta marketplace listing. Goal is to produce a single-paragraph description + 3 micro-copy variants that engineering and legal can sign off on quickly, and a pragmatic technical gate checklist the eng-integration team can run in under 4 hours per review.

Audience:
- GTM/Product (owner: Emily) for final copy selection
- Engineering (integration owner: Marco) for implementation and telemetry
- Legal/Privacy (Priya) for compliance gating
- Solutions/SE for demo scripts

Context & constraints (quick):
- This listing targets ISVs and platform teams who need low-latency, multi-region inference with predictable cost controls.
- The tile must fit marketplace limits: title <= 60 chars, subtitle <= 140 chars, long description <= 1,000 chars, one hero screenshot + optional 3 thumbnails.
- No customer PII examples in screenshots.
- Privacy: must declare data residency options and KMS integration availability.

Short tile copy (3 distinct directions; pick one):
1) Performance-forward (concise)
- Title: Redwood Inference — Predictable LLM Inference
- Subtitle: Fast, cost-aware LLM serving across hosted, dedicated & private deployments.
- 2-sentence body: Redwood Inference provides a single API to run text generation, chat, and embeddings with production SLAs. Choose hosted for speed, Dedicated for reserved capacity, or Private for regulated workloads — all with token-level cost insights.
- CTA: Try a free trial

2) Developer-first (instructional)
- Title: Ship LLM features faster with Redwood
- Subtitle: One API, consistent performance, and ops tooling for production inference.
- 2-sentence body: Developers get streaming responses, structured output, and rollouts with canaries and automatic fallback. Built-in batching, KV caching and model recommendations help reduce token costs while preserving results.
- CTA: Get started (API keys)

3) Enterprise-safe (compliance)
- Title: Enterprise LLM serving with strong isolation
- Subtitle: VPC, KMS/HSM integrations, and audit-ready logs for regulated teams.
- 2-sentence body: Run Redwood Private inside your VPC or on-prem; integrate with your KMS and SIEM. SLA-backed Dedicated capacity and per-route observability reduce risk during scale and rollouts.
- CTA: Request demo

Feature bullets (short; marketplace-friendly):
- Single REST API for generation, chat, embeddings and reranking
- Model catalog with verified performance profiles and quantization variants
- Streaming + function/tool-calling + structured outputs
- Dedicated pools, autoscaling policies and burst capacity
- VPC/private deployment, KMS/HSM support, audit logs
- Token-level cost & latency dashboards, per-route tracing

Technical acceptance checklist (minimal, pragmatic):
- Artifact and packaging:
  - Tile assets: hero image (16:9 PNG, 1200x675), 3 thumbnails (800x450), icon (128x128).
  - Metadata fields populated: title, subtitle, long_description, categories, tags, contact email.
- API smoke tests (integration script):
  - auth: obtain API key via test account and validate 401/403 behaviors
  - generation: call text-generation endpoint, validate 200 and non-empty text for a short prompt ("Summarize: Redwood Inference")
  - streaming: confirm chunked response delivered within 500ms of first token for sample prompt (region: us-west1)
- Resilience & routing:
  - fallback: simulate capacity limit (use lower-tier account or simulate header) and validate automatic fallback to cheaper variant (or documented message).
  - region routing: deploy proof that selecting region=eu-west reduces RTT by >= 40ms in eu-west test (scripted measurement).
- Security & compliance checks:
  - KMS: sample request with customer-managed-key header accepted or returns clear unsupported error message
  - Logs: verify audit log entry created for the sample request with no PII fields logged
- Telemetry & billing signals:
  - Token counts surfaced in usage sample file (CSV) and match returned tokens from API
  - Request latency recorded and visible in per-route dashboard snapshot (attach screenshot)
- Acceptance artifacts to attach:
  - test-run log (plain text), cURL examples, screenshots of per-route dashboard, hero/thumbnail assets, privacy statement snippet

Rollout plan (lean):
- Week 0: finalize copy variant and hero image; run legal & privacy quick review (3 business days).
- Week 1: engineering implements tile metadata + assets and runs integration smoke tests; attach artifact bundle.
- Week 2: SE-run demo with 3 customers (internal beta) and collect feedback.
- Week 3: lift to public marketplace listing with monitoring + 24h on-call during initial traffic spike.

Owner & responsibilities:
- GTM Copy + Launch owner: Emily Chen (final copy selection, marketplace submission)
- Engineering integration: Marco Ruiz (tile packaging, API smoke tests, telemetry screenshots)
- Legal/Privacy: Priya Desai (review privacy blurb and EULA flags)
- Solutions & Demo: Liam O'Connor (demo scripts, internal beta coordination)

Open questions / decisions needed (short):
- Which CTA drives conversion for us: "Try a free trial" vs "Request demo"? (A/B candidate; need expected conversion rates from growth team).
- Should we include explicit price ranges on tile or link to pricing page? (Legal suggests avoid MSRP; prefer link)
- Telemetry retention: marketplace requires 90 days of audit retention for tile test data — verify storage cost (SRE/infra).

Legal/Privacy suggested blurb (draft):
"Redwood Inference offers hosted, dedicated, and private deployment options. Customer data used for inference is not used to train upstream models by default; audit logs and data residency controls are available. For enterprise privacy and onboarding, see our privacy whitepaper (link)."

Demo script scratch (for SEs):
- Quick start: create account -> get API key -> run sample cURL (included below) -> show latency and token billing in Console -> toggle to Dedicated in UI and show per-route dashboard
- cURL sample: curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer <API_KEY>' -d '{"prompt":"Explain Redwood Inference in 20 words"}'

Notes to reviewers (freeform):
- This doc is intentionally compact to reduce back-and-forth. If legal needs more specific language around retention / training, attach exact clause and we will slot it into the long_description.
- Engineering: please attach the raw test-run log and a short README describing how to reproduce the smoke tests locally. Aim for reproducibility under 10 minutes.

Revision history (working):
- 2025-11-04: initial sketch (Emily)
- 2025-11-20: added technical acceptance checklist (Marco)
- 2025-12-15: privacy blurb draft (Priya)
- 2026-02-12: updated CTA variants and rollout schedule (Emily)

Unresolved action items (list):
- [ ] Growth: provide expected conversion lift targets for CTA A/B (due 2026-02-20)
- [ ] SRE: confirm audit retention cost (due 2026-02-18)
- [ ] Engineering: attach smoke-test log and PR link when ready (PR target: #58)

End of doc.
